newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard says no need for 8-9 pct unemployment.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard says no need for 8-9 pct unemployment.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday that Australians should not have to live with an unemployment rate of eight to nine percent.
"Nothing says that we have to live with unemployment of eight to nine percent," Howard told a retirees conference.
Australia's seasonally-adjusted unemployment rate stood at 8.7 percent in September.
"I'm not setting any unrealistic targets because I think that's a pointless exercise," Howard said.
"But what I am saying is that our committment to basically all policies that the government has developed towards reducing unemployment remains absolutely undiminished," he said.
Prime Minister John Howard announced on Monday the formation of a Cabinet employment committee to ensure that all policies affecting the labour market remained consistent.
The government forecast in its August 20 budget that unemployment would average 8.5 percent over 1996/97 to June 30 but would fall to 8.25 percent in the June quarter.
